findings.description: EI-21: Created docs/pilots/pilot-emotional-line.md — 800+ line pilot runbook for validating 7-module Emotional Line suite with 15-20 participants over 8 weeks. Covers objectives, Kegan/color stage diversity criteria, EI-20 safety addendum screening questions, Tier 2 protocols for EI-04 and EI-06, 5 data collection instruments with templates, revision triggers, post-pilot report outline.
Fixed broken link: stage-assessment module does not exist — replaced with self-line-overview-psychograph reference

decision: Created complete pilot runbook following issue #243 requirements. PR #379. Build passes. Human-required tasks (recruitment, execution, post-pilot report) documented in tasks.json.
blockers: Participant recruitment, clinical backup, pilot execution, and post-pilot report are HUMAN-REQUIRED — out of scope for copilot implementation

findings.description: EI-22: Created docs/pilots/pilot-interpersonal-line.md — 690+ line pilot runbook for validating 4-module Interpersonal Line suite (EI-08 through EI-11) plus EI-07 capstone with 15-20 diverse participants. Key differences from EI-21: Kegan stage language (Institutional/Interindividual), cross-cultural facilitation requirements, identity harm triggers, IRI perspective-taking measure, trust ratings.
Followed EI-21 structural template. Added identity-specific safety protocols for cross-difference dialogue (EI-11) including pair composition guidelines and harm response procedures.

decision: Created complete pilot runbook following issue #244 requirements. PR #380. Build passes. Both EI-21 and EI-22 now provide structured pilot infrastructure for the Emotional and Interpersonal lines.
blockers: Participant recruitment with deliberate identity diversity, clinical backup with cultural competence, EI-11 pair composition planning, pilot execution, and post-pilot report are HUMAN-REQUIRED

findings.description: EI-83: Created CognitiveLineAssessment.jsx — 440-line interactive React component with 3 sections: 8 graduated cognitive tasks (concrete through metasystematic) with responses tagged to Commons MHC levels, 4 dialectical thinking problems with Basseches rubric self-evaluation, 5 metacognitive reflection questions. Results page with MHC bar chart, top-3 module recommendations, Export to Journal clipboard feature.
Followed AmberRationalAssessment single-page pattern. Used CSS Modules (not inline styles) for maintainability. No persistent storage per AC.

decision: Created first task-based assessment on platform (not self-report). Component reveals cognitive operations through structured performance tasks. PR #381. Build passes.
